mcqs.q: In this Upper Egypt study, the seroprevalence of Bartonella henselae among the humans tested was approximately:
mcqs.e: Human seroprevalence by immunofluorescent assay was 46%.

mcqs.q: How was B. henselae detected in the cats?
o: Identified molecularly by PCR in 8% of blood samples
Detected only in saliva by serology
mcqs.e: Isolation failed, but PCR identified B. henselae in 8% (6/75) of cat blood samples.

mcqs.q: Human B. henselae infection was significantly higher in which setting?
mcqs.e: Infection was significantly higher in rural (79.5%) than urban (24.6%) regions (P<0.001).

mcqs.q: What transmission chain did the genetic data support in this Thailand case?
mcqs.e: Sequencing supported owner-to-cat then cat-to-veterinarian SARS-CoV-2 transmission.

mcqs.q: How was the veterinarian most likely infected?
o: Sneezed on by the infected cat
mcqs.e: The veterinarian was sneezed on by the infected cat before developing COVID-19.

mcqs.q: What evidence supported the cat-to-human transmission hypothesis?
mcqs.e: A genetic study of the viral genomes supported the transmission hypothesis.

mcqs.q: Canine circovirus (CanineCV) is mainly associated with which clinical syndrome in dogs?
mcqs.e: CanineCV is chiefly linked to hemorrhagic enteritis in canids.

mcqs.q: CanineCV is most often found in coinfection with which agent?
mcqs.e: In most cases CanineCV is found coinfecting with canine parvovirus type-2.

mcqs.q: The reported prevalence/frequency of CanineCV in studied populations ranged from:
mcqs.e: Reported prevalence ranged variably from 1% to 30%.

mcqs.q: What factor was positively associated with a higher histological AA-amyloidosis score in shelter cats?
o: Longer duration of stay in the shelter
mcqs.e: Longer shelter stay was significantly associated with a higher amyloidosis score.

mcqs.q: The major protein identified in the amyloid deposits was:
mcqs.e: Histopathology and immunofluorescence identified SAA as the major protein source.

mcqs.q: Detection of SAA fragments in bile raised the possibility of which transmission route?
mcqs.e: SAA fragments in bile secretions suggested possible fecal-oral transmission.

mcqs.q: Which wildlife species accounted for the most US rabies cases in 2021?
mcqs.e: Bats were the leading rabid host at 33.9% of cases.

mcqs.q: Among domestic animals, which had the most reported rabies cases in 2021?
mcqs.e: Cats (216 cases) led domestic animal rabies, exceeding cattle and dogs.

mcqs.q: How did total US animal rabies cases in 2021 compare with 2020?
mcqs.e: Cases fell 18.2% from 4,479 (2020) to 3,663 (2021), attributed to pandemic factors.

mcqs.q: This publication on brucellosis in the United States is best described as:
mcqs.e: The article is a one-health review of brucellosis in the US.

mcqs.q: A 'one-health' framing of brucellosis implies relevance to:
mcqs.e: One-health spans interconnected animal, human, and environmental health.

mcqs.q: What does the point-of-care dot blot ELISA detect?
mcqs.e: It screens for protective vaccinal antibody against CAV, CPV, and CDV.

mcqs.q: Across the three viral antigens, the index test's sensitivity was approximately:
mcqs.e: Sensitivity ranged from 96.03% to 96.75% for all three antigens.

mcqs.q: Per the conclusion, accurate immunity assessment lets clinicians:
o: Administer core vaccines appropriately and avoid unnecessary vaccine risk
mcqs.e: Knowing immune status guides appropriate core vaccination, avoiding unnecessary adverse-event risk.

mcqs.q: Which stray species accounted for most of the included brucellosis studies?
mcqs.e: Dogs made up 75.7% (28/37) of the included studies.

mcqs.q: All included studies of brucellosis in stray cattle were conducted in:
mcqs.e: All 7 stray cattle (cow-shelter) studies were from India.

mcqs.q: A key methodological limitation highlighted by the review was that:
o: All studies were randomized controlled trials
Diagnostic tests were uniform across studies
Few studies used probabilistic random sampling or justified sample size
mcqs.e: Only ~22% used probabilistic random sampling and ~14% justified sample size.

mcqs.q: The overall pooled seroprevalence of leptospiral antibodies in domestic cats was approximately:
mcqs.e: Overall seroprevalence was 11.7% (roughly 1 in 10 cats).

mcqs.q: Which cats had significantly higher odds of Leptospira infection?
mcqs.e: Outdoor cats had nearly threefold higher odds (OR 2.74).

mcqs.q: The public health conclusion regarding cats was that they:
o: Should be considered potential Leptospira carriers
mcqs.e: Cats should be considered potential Leptospira carriers in public health planning.

mcqs.q: What proportion of the tested imported dogs were positive for one or more exotic pathogens?
mcqs.e: 24% (32/133) tested positive for at least one exotic pathogen.

mcqs.q: Which exotic pathogen was identified most frequently?
mcqs.e: Leishmania was found in 10.5% of dogs, the highest of those tested.

mcqs.q: What did the study conclude about clinical signs and pathogen status?
o: No significant association between clinical signs and pathogens carried
mcqs.e: No significant association was found between presenting signs and pathogens detected, underscoring the need to screen imports.

mcqs.q: Which laboratory findings were significantly associated with PCR-positive tularemia in cats?
mcqs.e: Leukopenia and neutropenia were significantly more likely in PCR-positive cats.

mcqs.q: Common physical examination findings in cats with tularemia included:
o: Fever, peripheral lymphadenomegaly, and oral ulcers
mcqs.e: Affected cats frequently showed fever, lymphadenomegaly, and oral ulcers.

mcqs.q: Most affected cats had what type of lifestyle?
mcqs.e: Most were domestic shorthairs with outdoor access.

mcqs.q: The definitive hosts of Toxoplasma gondii are:
mcqs.e: Domestic cats and other Felidae serve as T. gondii definitive hosts.

mcqs.q: Which factor was associated with increased odds of T. gondii seropositivity?
mcqs.e: Cats older than 5 years had significantly higher seropositivity odds (IgG OR 2.6).

mcqs.q: What effect did FeLV/FIV-associated immunosuppression have on results?
mcqs.e: FeLV antigen and FIV antibody positivity significantly influenced serological results.
